items.title: From 300 to 150,000+: What MTN Nigeria’s FTTH Journey Teaches Us About Scaling Connectivity
items.summary: MTN Nigeria’s FTTH network has grown from barely 300 home connections to more than 150,000, showing how infrastructure, skilled people, vendor coordination and disciplined operating systems must evolve as connectivity moves from deployment to scale.

items.title: T-Mobile, Jio claim world first with 5G SA roaming
items.summary: T-Mobile and Jio claim they made wireless history by achieving the world's first 5G Standalone (SA) roaming connection – one that supports both data and voice services.

items.title: As Cambium folds, Airspan snaps up FWA products
items.summary: Airspan adds to its industrial 5G FWA portfolio as Cambium looks to sell off its enterprise business.

items.title: OpenVault tackles broadband need for better upstream optimization
items.summary: As the industry shifts from DOCSIS 3.1 to DOCSIS 4.0, the need to manage channels, carriers, service groups and network activity has risen exponentially.

items.title: Verizon, T-Mobile kick the tires on 4 GHz
items.summary: Spectrum policy decisions are still up in the air, but Verizon and T-Mobile are already lining up experiments for the 4 GHz band.

items.title: AT&T pursues 3.45 GHz through N Squared leases
items.summary: AT&T is asking for the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) for permission to access even more 3.45 GHz spectrum to bolster its network.

items.title: Cable net promoter scores improve while fixed wireless NPS declines
items.summary: Cable executives have admitted on earnings calls that their reputations with customers are pretty dismal, and they’re working hard to earn back customer good will.

items.title: Opinion: A SpaceX terrestrial wireless network could be challenging
items.summary: Building a fourth, nationwide U.S. wireless network would require massive time, capital, and execution, while other routes may be more practical.

items.title: Huawei Takes NPO From the Lab Into the AI Machine
items.summary: Huawei has built its 7.2T Hi-ONE near-packaged optical engine into the new Atlas 960E SuperPoD. NPO has moved remarkably quickly from an architectural argument to standards work, functioning hardware and now an AI computing system.

items.title: Fiber sensing may have helped prevent fiber cut that caused massive flight delays
items.summary: The problems began when a communications circuit at a flight control center failed. But the backup solution, a fiber optic cable, had been cut.
